name: app.veriql/veriql-mcp
title: Veriql Risk
description: Before an agent pays: USDT pre-send, payee, signature and freeze checks read off chain.

environmentVariables.name: VERIQL_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: An EVM wallet holding a little USDC on Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Avalanche. Each call pays $0.005-$0.05 over x402: no account, no key. Set this or VERIQL_API_KEY.

environmentVariables.name: VERIQL_MAX_USD_PER_CALL
environmentVariables.description: Refuse any single payment above this many USD.

environmentVariables.name: VERIQL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Prepaid credits from https://veriql.app/api, instead of a wallet.

environmentVariables.name: VERIQL_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API origin. Only needed for self-hosting.
